name: PasteCellsToExcelWorksheetNode
label: Paste Cells to Excel Worksheet

author: @aventisia

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet where cells will be pasted.

fields.name: PasteMode
fields.label: Paste Mode

selectOptions.label: On Named Cells
selectOptions.description: Pastes data into a named range.

selectOptions.label: On Currently Active Cell
selectOptions.description: Pastes data starting from the currently active cell.

selectOptions.label: On Specified Cell
selectOptions.description: Pastes data starting from a specific column and row.

fields.name: Column
fields.label: Column
fields.description: The column letter or number of the target cell for pasting.

fields.name: Row
fields.label: Row
fields.description: The row number of the target cell for pasting.

fields.name: Name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: The name of the target named range.

fields.name: PasteType
fields.label: Paste Type
fields.description: The type of paste operation to perform.

selectOptions.label: All
